title: Compound Components
description: Learn the compound components pattern for flexible, expressive APIs.
longDescription: Compound components let a parent component share implicit state with child components through context, so users can compose the UI declaratively. You will build Tabs, Accordions, Menus, and context-powered compound components.
whatYouLearn: Understand what compound components are and why they enable flexible APIs
Share implicit state between parent and child components using context
Build common compound component patterns like Tabs, Accordion, and Menu
Create context-backed compound components with proper error handling
Apply the pattern to design expressive, user-controlled component APIs
